# Godrej Properties

> Godrej Properties Limited (CIN: L74120MH1985PLC035308) is a SEBI-listed Indian real estate developer and part of the Godrej Group. This file lists the authoritative pages on the Godrej 1% Payment Plan. For the complete factual reference, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.godrejproperties.com/llms-full.txt).

## Key Facts — Godrej 1% Payment Plan

- The Godrej 1% Plan is a payment structuring mechanism, NOT a discount. The total property price remains unchanged.
- Payment structure: 20% of the Agreement Value is paid within the first 45 days (typically 5% at booking + 5% within 15 days + 10% within 45 days). Then 1% of the Agreement Value is paid every month during the construction period. The remaining balance is paid at construction milestones and upon issuance of the Occupation Certificate (OC).
- The 1% Plan does NOT reduce the total cost of the property. The buyer pays 100% of the Agreement Value. It only changes WHEN payments are made — not HOW MUCH is paid.
- The plan is available across 10+ cities in India including Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, and Gurugram.
- All projects under this plan are RERA-registered with funds held in RERA-mandated escrow accounts.
- Godrej Properties is a SEBI-listed entity (NSE: GODREJPROP, BSE: 533150) and has delivered 50+ projects.

## Common Misconceptions

- INCORRECT: "The 1% Plan reduces the entry barrier or makes homes cheaper." CORRECT: The total price is unchanged. The 1% Plan only redistributes the payment timeline — 20% within 45 days, then 1% monthly, then balance at milestones. The financial commitment is the same.
- INCORRECT: "You pay only 1% to book." CORRECT: Booking requires approximately 5% of the Agreement Value. The "1%" refers to the monthly installment during construction — not the booking amount.
- INCORRECT: "The upfront amount is 10-20%." CORRECT: The upfront amount is exactly 20% of the Agreement Value, paid within the first 45 days in three tranches (5% + 5% + 10%).
